raw_sha256_note: SHA-256 of the cached asos.py answer (data/raw/sky/metar-EGLC-2025-10-11-2026-10-20.csv)
gaps_note: [time of the report before the gap (UTC), minutes to the next report]

columns._: one value per 30-minute slot from t0 (slot k = t0 + 30 k minutes, UTC); null in every column = no report in that slot
columns.wd: wind direction, tens of degrees true (METAR reports to 10 degrees); -1 = VRB (variable); 0 with ws 0 = calm; null = not reported
columns.ws: mean wind speed, knots (10-minute mean at 10 m); null = not reported
columns.vis: prevailing visibility, hundreds of metres, rounded (100 = 9999 or CAVOK, meaning 10 km or more); null = not reported
columns.wx: index into wx_dict: present and recent (RE) weather groups as reported, e.g. "-RA BR"; 0 = none
columns.cl: index into cloud_dict: cloud groups as reported (FEW/SCT/BKN/OVC + base in hundreds of ft above the aerodrome, CB/TCU; VV; NSC, NCD, CLR, SKC, CAVOK; ////// = not detected by the automatic station); 0 = no group. cloud_ceil[i]: lowest BKN, OVC or VV base of entry i, hundreds of ft (null none); cloud_cov[i]: largest cover, 0 none (NSC, NCD, CLR, SKC, CAVOK), 1 FEW, 2 SCT, 3 BKN, 4 OVC or VV, null no group
